title: Link radar, September 9, 2026
description: Link radar Sep 9: machine-checked proof from an agent run, faster image model, petabyte variant catalogue, quantum handshakes, sandbox.
lead: Frontier labs and infra providers shipped a dense day of primary-source reading on September 8: a machine-checked mathematics proof produced by a very large agent run, a faster image generation model with new editing controls, a petabyte-scale catalogue of human DNA variant effects, post-quantum origin handshakes rolling out across billions of daily connections, and centrally managed sandboxes for coding assistants in IDEs. Each summary below is in our own words; follow the links for the originals.
